links.comparator_used: LLM-only (training knowledge alone, no retrieved context)
links.outcome: Accuracy of biomarker-driven treatment recommendations across 234 therapy-biomarker relationships
links.effect: LLM-only 62–75% accuracy; RAG-LLM 79–91% with an unstructured database and 94–95% with a structured database. Structured augmentation also raised precision (49% to 80%) and F1-score (57% to 84%) compared with unstructured augmentation. On actual oncologist queries, RAG-LLM achieved 81–90% accuracy.
links.tradeoff: Further work is needed to generate reliable responses for ambiguous or unsupported clinical scenarios.
links.quote: While LLM-only achieved 62–75% accuracy in biomarker-driven treatment recommendations, RAG-LLM achieved 79–91% accuracy with an unstructured database and 94–95% accuracy with a structured database.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with curated knowledge base
